summary: Iteration 3 — validated new features: (a) /api/analyze/async + /api/analyze/status polling job pipeline, (b) /api/analyze/stream SSE fast path, (c) LOLBAS catalog admin (status + sync + admin/stats.lolbas sub-object), (d) frontend Attack Graph click-to-filter, Final Summary card, PNG/SVG snapshot buttons, and Admin LOLBAS Catalog UI. Added /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (11 new tests, all pass). Full backend regression: 57/57 pytest tests pass (58.57s). LOLBAS live counts confirmed: active=248, source=239, defaults=40 (exact match to spec). Auto Investigate polling flow completed with full render in ~56s. All key data-testids present and functional. No browser console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: In-memory _JOBS dict for async analysis pipeline is fine for single-replica preview but will not survive backend restart / horizontal scale. Consider promoting to MongoDB or Redis before multi-replica deploy.

SSE /analyze/stream is documented to be killed at ~60s by K8s ingress — this is now correctly worked around by the frontend using the polling pair (/analyze/async + /analyze/status). Behavior verified.
server.py is ~1840 lines — approaching the >700-line threshold for splitting; consider modularizing analyze/, admin/, threat-intel/ into routers when time permits.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Tests write/clean TEST_ prefixed OSINT keys only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests: `python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v` runs all 57 tests (~60s). test_new_features.py covers: analyze/async→status polling completion within 120s, analyze/stream SSE content-type + first-event delivery, /admin/lolbas/status (active/source/defaults/last_updated/source_url), /admin/lolbas/sync + count match on subsequent /status, /admin/stats.lolbas sub-object, 401/403 on unauth, and analyze/operations regression.
